name: PlotSkeleton
description:
The plot's placeholder: the chart's own shape in the plot's exact box (R9.3), so swapping
in the data moves nothing. Built from Skeleton parts; the shimmer is the page's one beat.
signature: ({ kind, tier }: { kind: ChartKind; tier: ChartTier; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: kind
props.description: Chart shape family; picks the placeholder marks.

props.name: tier
props.description: Size tier of the box; axes placeholders show only in `full` for line, column, scatter and heatmap charts.
